_comment: Licence signing keys pinned into this release. This is the root of trust for offline licence
verification: a key listed here cannot be changed without replacing the binary.
Fill it from the licence authority before cutting a release:
While it is empty the install trusts no keys of its own and must learn them from
app.license.server-url before it can verify a licence. An air-gapped deployment therefore needs
this file filled in; a connected one will fetch and then cache the set on first contact.
